master_resumes.professional_summary: Accomplished Business Analyst and Product Owner with ~9 years of verified cross-functional experience across Semiconductor Manufacturing, Public Sector Health Eligibility Systems, FinTech Bridge Architectures, Financial Market Data Platforms, and E-Commerce Digital Payments. experience.title: Business Analyst
responsibilities: Steer the product roadmap for advanced semiconductor wafer fabrication technologies, translating complex engineering parameters into high-impact customer-facing features.
Synthesize market research and quantitative customer insights to align engineering, manufacturing, and global sales departments on key product deliverables.
Provide dedicated global customer technical product and application support for advanced wafer manufacturing lines.
Formulate data-driven pricing models and financial forecasting leveraging Tableau and Power BI analytical dashboards.
Lead executive prioritization sessions and customer advocacy forums to resolve technical tradeoffs and accelerate contract discussions.
achievements: Engineered predictive financial forecasting models in Tableau/Power BI that informed executive contract negotiations.
Bridged global customer technical escalations directly into manufacturing release sprints, drastically reducing feedback turnaround.
experience.domain: Wafer Fabrication, Industrial Analytics & Supply Chain

experience.title: Senior Business Analyst
responsibilities: Directed the end-to-end product roadmap for a large-scale enterprise Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment System.
Governed feature delivery, technical tradeoffs, and sprint milestones across engineering, platform architecture, and system integration teams.
Extracted and operationalized customer insights to automate manual state-level eligibility workflows.
Instituted operational KPI dashboards and business intelligence reporting inside Jira and Agile frameworks.
achievements: Spearheaded process automation and eligibility workflow streamlining that achieved a 30% operational effectiveness improvement.
Delivered complex regulatory integration sprints ahead of multi-agency compliance deadlines.
experience.industry: Public Sector & Health and Human Services (HHS)
experience.domain: Enterprise Eligibility, Enrollment Platforms & State Digital Services

experience.title: Business Analyst
responsibilities: Defined and delivered the product roadmap for enterprise bridge software orchestrating data exchange between disparate financial data platforms.
Evaluated cloud architecture and informed core technology decisions alongside principal software engineers and operational leads.
Analyzed technical architecture versus pricing tradeoffs to establish go-to-market (GTM) pricing tiers.
Chaired user acceptance testing (UAT), regression cycles, and user advocacy councils across customer testing groups.
achievements: Engineered bridge software specifications enabling seamless bidirectional data synchronization across legacy and modern cloud finance systems.
Standardized UAT acceptance criteria that cut post-deployment defects by over 25%.
experience.domain: Financial Data Integration, Cloud Middleware & API Interoperability

experience.title: Associate Product Specialist
responsibilities: Contributed to the financial services product roadmap, developing technical feature specifications for financial analysis suites.
Conducted competitor market research and pricing strategy analysis to optimize product profitability and adoption.
Collaborated with marketing to execute targeted digital campaigns and delivered technical sales support for institutional finance clients.
Authored in-depth technical documentation, API specifications, and product release guides for investment professionals.
achievements: Synthesized market research that directly informed the rollout of a refreshed pricing tier for institutional market data feeds.
Assisted technical sales teams on complex institutional client RFPs and bespoke workflow integrations.
experience.domain: Investment Analytics, Market Data Feeds & FinTech Workstations

experience.title: Business Analyst
responsibilities: Functioned as primary product roadmap liaison bridging cross-border engineering teams with e-commerce and banking stakeholders.
Conducted rigorous business problem decomposition, authored comprehensive BRDs, process flow diagrams, and workflow models.
Drove digital payment integration initiatives, coordinating functional, non-functional, performance, reliability, and security testing.
Coordinated technical integrations with third-party payment gateways and strategic banking partners.
achievements: Architected end-to-end payment workflow models ensuring ISO/PCI-DSS regulatory compliance across digital transaction corridors.
Delivered 100% test scenario coverage across functional and security integration matrices.
experience.domain: Core Banking, Digital Payments & Transaction Gateways

experience.title: Business Analyst Intern
responsibilities: Supported roadmap implementation and executed change management initiatives across academic software systems.
Conducted extensive competitor benchmarking across 5 industry-leading cloud education and learning management platforms.
Evaluated emerging cloud education market trends to prioritize 3 high-impact product improvements.
achievements: Formulated competitive matrix evaluating 5 ed-tech platforms that prioritized 3 high-adoption student portal enhancements.
experience.domain: Academic Portals, Student Information Systems & Cloud Learning
